item.title: About me
item.author: eninambrices@gmail.com (Eninam Brice SIOU)
item.description: I am Eninam Brice SIOU, an engineering student specializing in Cybersecurity and Cyber-intelligence. After completing my 4th year at ENSA Tanger, I am preparing a double degree at Polytech Angers specializing in automated systems. Currently undertaking my PFA internship at Sanasoft, my work focuses on post-quantum cryptography applied to critical infrastructure. My technical environment revolves around Pop!_OS, Neovim, Docker, and Kubernetes.
